events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Start the work and secure access
events.decision: Can the COO and Head of Claims open access to claims data and interviewees?
agenda: Present the problem, the scope boundary and the plan of work
Review the claims data and interviews the first weeks need
Decide who opens access to claims data and interviewees

events.label: Check-in: early findings
events.purpose: Check early findings and the baseline
events.decision: Confirm the baseline as the reference for measuring settlement time and satisfaction?
agenda: Present the interview synthesis of pain points by claims line
Review the settlement time and satisfaction baseline
Confirm the baseline as the reference for later results

events.label: Go/no-go on design
events.purpose: Decide whether to move into design
events.decision: Go on to design, and which causes of delay must the target model address?
agenda: Review the step map and the motor lean carry-over findings
Present the diagnostic readout on the causes of delay
Decide go or no-go on design and the causes it must address

events.label: Workshop 1: model options
events.purpose: Choose the model option to detail
events.decision: Which claims operating model option goes forward to detailed design?
agenda: Present the claims operating model options and their comparison
Discuss how each option addresses the agreed causes of delay
Decide which option goes forward to detailed design

events.label: Workshop 2: detailed design
events.purpose: Review the design and set transition focus
events.decision: Which parts of the detailed design should the transition plan cover first?
agenda: Present the detailed design of the chosen claims model
Discuss what the design changes for property and health claims
Decide which parts the transition plan covers first

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Approve the final package for the Board
events.decision: Approve the final report, roadmap and Board presentation for the 15 March 2027 Board?
agenda: Present the transition roadmap and change plan
Review the final report and the Board presentation
Decide on approval ahead of the Board meeting on 15 March 2027
